The Cost of Waiting

What Happens If You Defer a Hazard Tree

Deferred hazard trees in NE Ohio don't stay quiet. Between EAB-killed ash and the freeze-thaw wind events that hit Cuyahoga and Geauga counties every winter, the trees that fail this year are almost always the ones a homeowner "was going to get to."

  • Dead limbs fall in wind — a single storm can cost more in insurance deductible than proactive removal.
  • Leaning trees uproot when root plates saturate — foundation and driveway repairs run five figures.
  • Insurance premiums rise after a claim; municipal fines apply if canopy threatens right-of-way in permit-required villages.
  • EAB-killed ash goes from stable to structurally compromised in one growing season.

Answers

Frequently Asked Questions

The questions we hear most from NE Ohio homeowners — with straight answers, not sales copy.

How fast can Roubic respond to an emergency tree removal?
Our 24/7 emergency line is answered directly by a Roubic team member. In Tier 1 cities (Auburn Township, Pepper Pike, Chagrin Falls, Moreland Hills, Solon), after-hours response is typically 1–2 hours. Business-hours response across the full 40-mile radius averages 2–4 hours.
Does Roubic provide free estimates for tree removal?
Yes — every Roubic estimate is free, with no trip charge and no obligation. Aaron or a lead foreman walks your property in person, documents access and hazards, and provides a written estimate before you commit to anything.
What services does Roubic offer besides tree removal?
Six core services: tree removal, ANSI A300 tree trimming and pruning, stump grinding, land clearing (lot + brush), 24/7 storm damage / emergency response, and seasoned firewood delivery.
How much does tree removal cost in NE Ohio?
Prices are confirmed from Aaron's 2026 job records: small trees under 30 ft run $400–$800; medium 30–60 ft $650–$950; large 60–80 ft $850–$2,000; very-large or crane-required jobs $2,000–$5,000+. Every estimate is free.
Is Roubic insured?
Yes — Roubic Tree & Landscape LLC is fully insured. General liability + workers-comp certificates available on request and delivered as part of the insurance-documentation packet on every storm / tree-on-structure job.
What cities does Roubic serve?
13 NE Ohio cities within a 40-mile radius of our Auburn Township yard. Tier 1: Auburn Township (HQ), Pepper Pike, Chagrin Falls, Moreland Hills, Solon. Tier 2: Gates Mills, Beachwood, Orange, Bainbridge Township, Shaker Heights. Tier 3: Chesterland, Mayfield, South Russell.
Does Roubic work with insurance for storm-damage claims?
Yes. Every storm / tree-on-structure job includes an insurance-documentation packet — photos, written scope, and a signed estimate — designed to be submitted directly to your homeowner's insurance carrier.
What makes Roubic different from national tree service brands?
Two-generation family business, same Auburn Township yard since 1982, full owned equipment fleet (no rental gap, no subcontracting on core work), 10-year-tenured field foreman, and {{global.owner_name}} personally visits every job site. When you call Roubic, you're not navigating a chain of franchises or a rotating regional manager.
